layers.authority: Con Dao National Park Management Board (Ban quan ly Vuon quoc gia Con Dao), Con Dao Special Zone, Ho Chi Minh City
layers.process: The park board offers night viewing of nesting sea turtles and turtle-hatchling releases as its own organised tours (codes CDP 009 and CDP 008). Both depart from the park fee office at 36 Ton Duc Thang street. The board's site lists no independent way to watch nesting, so the tour is the route it publishes. The board's tourism page gives the night-viewing tour a price of VND 2,150,000 to VND 5,100,000 (about A$118 to A$281, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, VND 18,157 per A$1), and its tourism hotline is 0983 830 669.

layers.authority: Con Dao National Park Management Board
layers.process: The board runs the park's island and marine sightseeing as tours with a published price filter of about VND 1,000,000 to more than VND 5,000,000 depending on length (half day to two days).

zone-requirements.note: Con Dao (formerly Ba Ria - Vung Tau province) now sits in Ho Chi Minh City since the 2025 merger; the board's own page gives its address as Con Dao Special Zone, Ho Chi Minh City. The board's rules page (noi quy bao ve VQG) is an image and could not be read, so conduct rules on the beaches were not recorded. Nesting season dates were not taken from an official page.

laws.rule: The Vietnamese Government doesn't permit official Long Tan commemorations at the Long Tan Cross site in Ba Ria Ward (formerly Ba Ria-Vung Tau Province). Media coverage isn't permitted. Access stays open to small groups making private visits, and this may change at short notice.
